summary: Washington County, ID ground cabin on Payette NF land: c.1932 cabin with roof platform, last staffed 1944; listed gone, no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site a hike-in. No source describes access today.

William Davis listed as known lookout staff

corrections.why: Both sources say 1944 was the last year the lookout was staffed. They do not say it was abandoned that year.

sources.title: Cuddy Point Lookout - Idaho Fire Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Thin record: four pages repeat the same facts (c.1932 cabin with roof platform, William Davis 1942, last staffed 1944). Forest Lookouts cites 'Kresek' for its date; that book was not located. No source describes the site today or its access. Elevation 7,715 ft is now in facts and is cited to firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts only (Forest Lookouts gives no elevation). Proposed correction: brief event '1944 abandoned' should read staffed_last, since sources give only the last staffed year.
